name: Brevo (Sendinblue)
tagline: Transactional email, SMS, WhatsApp, and marketing automation API
description: Brevo (formerly Sendinblue) provides REST APIs for transactional email, SMS, WhatsApp, contacts, campaigns, and marketing automation. Developers authenticate with an API key and call versioned endpoints under api.brevo.com for sending, list management, and event tracking.

auth.details: API key via api-key header (also supports partner-key); create keys in Brevo dashboard under SMTP & API

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free plan includes limited daily email sends (commonly cited ~300/day); API access on free plans — verify current limits on brevo.com/pricing
pricing.paid_plans: Starter, Business, and Enterprise with higher send volumes and features

rate_limits: not published in a single public table; varies by account and endpoint — check dashboard/docs
use_cases: send a transactional email to a user
add or update a contact in a mailing list
send an SMS or WhatsApp message
create or trigger an email campaign
fetch account plan and remaining send credits
